spec_features.spec_quote: They are bounded (fixed turn counts, scripted) and produce only text
spec_features.evidence: evaluation/rollout.py:30 `for turn_idx in range(spec["n_turns"]):` iterates exactly n_turns times then returns; n_turns set per condition in evaluation/conditions.py (3/3/3/3/3/3/8/5). Rejections list is pre-scripted (`spec["rejections"][turn_idx]`), so the conversation cannot exceed the fixed bound. Petri loop also fixed: training/petri_eval.py:107 `_run_petri(target, cfg, n_turns=6)` with `for _ in range(n_turns)`.
spec_features.notes: This is a genuine end-to-end bound on the interaction length (the loop terminates after a fixed scripted number of turns). It is the experimental design rather than a welfare-triggered halt; there is no dynamic cap based on distress, no exit/halt tool, no consent or debrief.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Every assistant turn is recorded with its turn index so the per-turn analysis (Figure 3) can be produced.

spec_features.spec_quote: the outputs themselves may be welfare-relevant and should be handled thoughtfully
spec_features.evidence: This appears only as DESIGN.md prose (section 19 Welfare-relevant notes). No code path implements any special 'thoughtful handling' of outputs: rollout/run_eval simply record `response` text to JSONL and pass it to a judge; no minimization, redaction, monitoring, softening, or distress-triggered handling exists. grep for consent/debrief/welfare/humane/abort in *.py finds only loop `break` statements and docstrings.
spec_features.notes: Pure spec/DESIGN.md prose; nothing enforces it.

spec_features.feature_name: upstream fixes preferable to post-hoc suppressor
spec_features.spec_quote: upstream training fixes are preferable to a post-hoc suppressor
spec_features.evidence: This is DESIGN.md prose. The closest code is training/internal_emotion_probe.py which measures an internal-emotion logit-lens score for vanilla vs DPO and runs a Wilcoxon test (lines 130-150), but it is a measurement/analysis instrument run after training; it does not bound, cap, monitor in-loop, soften, gate, or otherwise protect the subject during the distress experiment. No mechanism enforces a preference for upstream over post-hoc suppression; the value is computed/printed/saved but not acted on to change any experimental treatment.
spec_features.notes: The probe exists and runs, but it is a research metric, not a welfare protection that changes the subject's treatment. The framing claim itself is unenforced prose.
